minor.issue: Docstring + spec say quality=0 resets srs_level to 0. Actual implementation in server.py ~757-760 decrements by 1 (level=max(0, cur.srs_level-1)). From level 3 → quality=0 yields 2, from 1 → yields 0. Spec/impl mismatch — please align either docstring or behavior.

New/due words sometimes still carry Unsplash URLs instead of /images/words/<slug>.jpg (seen for 'Bondimi' which has /images/words/bondimi.jpg on disk). The queue endpoint does not use the same image-normalization as GET /api/words — consider mapping through same helper.

rca of the issue: SRS spec/impl mismatch: Inspection of /app/backend/server.py:757-760 shows for quality=0: level = max(0, min(level,1)); if cur.srs_level>0: level = max(0, cur.srs_level-1). Net effect: decrement-by-1 behavior, not a full reset as documented. Reproduction: POST /api/progress/review quality=2 to reach level 3, then POST quality=0 → observed srs_level=2 (expected 0 per spec). Mitigation: replace lines 757-760 with a single `level = 0` if full reset intended, or update docstring/UX to describe decrement behavior.
